title: The Ridge Where Climbing Becomes Staying

features.name: the-peak-that-stays-empty
features.desc-on-touch: You reach the top and discover there is no higher ground because you stopped moving. The ridge teaches: arrival is not ascent.

features.name: the-resting-place
features.desc-on-touch: Others have stopped here. Their footprints do not lead further. The ridge learned long ago that learning to stay is harder than learning to climb.

features.name: the-horizontal-way
features.desc-on-touch: The path you took to get here curves back on itself without circling. Motion and stillness become the same direction.

features.name: the-lesson-carved-in-air
features.desc-on-touch: A thousand climbers have come and learned this: the mountain does not move when you stop. You had to do all the moving.

inscription: you are here because the climb taught you that here was not higher

file.name: Ridge_Meditation_Log_Multiple_Walkers_1998-2024.txt
file.note: Entries from climbers who reached this ridge. Each entry says something like 'stopped,' 'stayed,' 'learned to rest.' One entry is dated 50 years in the future.

exits.label: back to the plateau where sideways was still climbing
toward the high country where heights stop mattering
where others came to learn that staying is a kind of journey
